title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04
lineage: SBD > RM > Cass > ? > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a hot June 4, 1970 Fillmore run with smoking St. Stephen, Midnight Hour and a soulful Baby Blue
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard tape – guitars front‑and‑center, crisp drums and clear organ – with only a few brief pauses on “Baby Blue”. The performance shines: a full‑on St. Stephen jam, a funky Midnight Hour that weaves in China Cat Sunflower/I Know You Rider, and an especially soulful “All Over Now Baby Blue” driven by Pigpen’s churchy organ and Jerry’s vocal warmth.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, praising both the musical flow and the clear soundboard source; only minor recording hiccups are noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Guitars out front, drums crisp, organ and vocals well balanced. A few short pauses on the Baby Blue segment but overall clear and listenable.

standout_songs: It's All Over Now Baby Blue
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight jams and smooth transitions; the band rides a hot second set that builds from St. Stephen into Midnight Hour and closes with an emotionally resonant Baby Blue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone praised as perfect; his voice paired with Pigpen’s organ highlighted on “Baby Blue”.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ described as extra‑churchy and superb; Bobby (likely Bob Weir) noted high in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums described as crisp and tight throughout.
